happening.subject: anchor/node-yard
happening.text: The visitor stands in the chapel yard as the boat's bell rings from the jetty.

happening.subject: anchor/high-platform
happening.text: The visitor lands on the high platform under the lid.

objectives.hint: Go out through the yard's gate onto the wall-walk. Run and leap each gap to the high platform under the stone lid.
objectives.title: Leap to the high platform under the lid

happening.subject: anchor/high-platform
happening.text: The visitor stands on the high platform; the jetty is past the last leap.

happening.subject: anchor/jetty-head
happening.text: The visitor reaches the boat at the head of the jetty.

objectives.hint: Leap down off the high platform, under the lid, and walk out to the far end of the jetty.
objectives.title: Walk to the end of the jetty
